model_summary: Implemented all three pgtbl lab tasks in /app/pgtbl. (1) Speed up getpid: added PTE_A to riscv.h, added struct usyscall *usyscall to proc.h, allocated/initialized/freed the usyscall page in proc.c (allocproc/freeproc), and mapped it read-only (PTE_R|PTE_U) at USYSCALL in proc_pagetable, unmapping it in proc_freepagetable. (2) vmprint: added recursive vmprint() in vm.c printing 'page table %p' then each valid PTE with ' ..' depth indentation, index, pte and pa; prototype in defs.h; called from exec.c when p->pid==1. (3) pgaccess: implemented sys_pgaccess() in sysproc.c using argaddr/argint, walk(), PTE_A check-and-clear, and copyout of the bitmask (limit 64 pages). Verified by building and running pgtbltest in qemu: ugetpid_test OK, pgaccess_test OK, all tests succeeded; vmprint output matches the spec format. Limitation: only the provided pgtbltest was run; the hidden grader's exact pte-printout regex was not independently executed.
